title: The Step-by-Step SMS Guide (eBook)
description:
Build, run and prove a safety management system for BVLOS drone operations, following 14 CFR Part 5, FAA AC 120-92D and ICAO Annex 19.

An 85-page PDF guide written for small and medium UAS operators.

Includes:
• Nine build steps: gap analysis, policy, risk management, reporting, assurance, promotion, records, emergency response, roll-out
• Five fully worked risk assessments (lost C2 link, road crossing, crewed aircraft, fatigue, change management)
• The AC 120-92D sample risk matrix with ICAO risk-index codes, acceptance rules and the META method
• Special topics: suppliers, human factors, SMS to waiver package, preparing for Part 108
• Part 5 and ICAO Annex 19 crosswalks, forms, sample safety policy, 40-item checklist, glossary
• Diagrams throughout

FAA and ICAO references only.

title: UAS Hazard and Risk Control Catalog (eBook)
description:
A working reference of 34 BVLOS hazards with example ratings before and after controls, preventive and recovery controls, evidence and indicators.

A 47-page PDF catalog that follows 14 CFR Part 5, AC 120-92D and ICAO Annex 19.

Includes:
• 34 hazards in eight groups: aircraft, C2 link, airspace, ground risk, people, environment, maintenance, planning and response
• For each hazard: causes, consequences, ratings (AC 120-92D matrix, ICAO codes), controls, evidence to keep, indicators
• How to choose and justify controls, and how to prove they work
• Index of hazards and ratings, control register template, abbreviations

Pair it with the SMS Risk Register Workbook.

title: UAS SMS Manual Template (Word)
description:
A complete, editable SMS manual for a UAS operator, structured on 14 CFR Part 5 and ICAO Annex 19.

An editable Word document of about 43 pages. Fill the highlighted fields and adapt.

Includes:
• Part 5 compliance statement with chapter and evidence for every requirement
• 12 chapters: policy, accountability, emergency response, safety risk management, change, reporting, assurance, training, records, BVLOS interface, suppliers
• Severity and likelihood scales, the AC 120-92D risk matrix, acceptance rules and a worked example
• 10 forms (F-1 to F-10) and the ICAO Annex 19 crosswalk
• Retention periods, SPI tables, management review agenda
• 14 diagrams

Not legal advice. Not endorsed by the FAA.

title: BVLOS ConOps Template (Word)
description:
An editable Concept of Operations for a BVLOS operation, built around what the FAA asks for in a Part 107 waiver request.

An editable Word document of about 23 pages.

Includes:
• Operation summary and rules to be waived (§107.31 and related)
• Aircraft, C2 link, navigation and contingency functions
• Operating area and ground risk; airspace, air risk and detection-time budget
• Crew, training, procedures, go / no-go criteria, contingencies
• Safety risk assessment with the AC 120-92D matrix, before and after controls
• Limits, assurance, proposed conditions and evidence index

Use with the SMS Manual Template and the Waiver Kit.

title: BVLOS Flight Checklist Pack (PDF + Word)
description:
Printable and editable checklists for the full BVLOS mission, from planning to debrief.

A ZIP with the pack as PDF (19 pages, ready to print) and Word (editable).

Includes:
• 15 checklists: planning, site and airspace, crew briefing, aircraft, GCS and C2 link, detect-and-avoid, batteries, go / no-go, in-flight monitoring, approach, post-flight, observers, night add-on, maintenance
• 10 contingency and emergency cards (lost link, flyaway, low battery, GNSS loss, traffic, person in path, motor failure, weather, battery fire, injury)
• Forms: mission risk check with the AC 120-92D matrix, go / no-go record, flight log, briefing record

title: UAS Emergency Response Plan Template (Word)
description:
An editable emergency response plan for UAS operators that meets the coordination requirement of 14 CFR §5.27.

An editable Word document of about 18 pages.

Includes:
• Emergency levels, roles, succession and call order
• Nine scenario cards: lost link, flyaway, person hurt, battery fire, traffic conflict, navigation loss, medical, weather, security
• Notification matrix (NTSB, §107.9, waiver conditions, insurer, customer)
• Site control, evidence preservation, media statement, return-to-operations conditions
• Drills, contact list, emergency log, witness statement, drill report, one-page quick reference

Not legal advice. Check current reporting rules.

title: Part 107 BVLOS Waiver Application Kit (Word)
description:
Worksheets and templates to prepare a request to waive §107.31 and related Part 107 rules.

An editable Word document of about 23 pages.

Includes:
• Is a waiver the right tool? Decision guide and readiness check
• The FAA application process and the Waiver Safety Explanation Guidelines, summarized
• Nine worksheets for the safety explanation: operation, aircraft, people, air risk, ground risk, procedures, emergencies, safety management, section-specific questions
• Hazard table before and after controls with the AC 120-92D matrix, traceability and evidence plan
• 18-point pre-submission checklist, common gaps, after-approval guide
• Example safety explanation, cover letter, timeline planner

A waiver is an FAA decision. The kit does not promise approval.

title: SMS Risk Register and Matrix Workbook (Excel)
description:
A ready-to-use risk register with automatic risk index and rating, using the AC 120-92D sample matrix with ICAO codes.

An Excel workbook with 8 sheets and formulas pre-built.

Includes:
• Editable matrix, severity and likelihood scales, acceptance rules
• Risk register with 34 BVLOS hazards pre-loaded as examples, automatic index, rating, who must accept and review flags
• One-page SRM worksheet
• SPI tracker with Green / Amber / Red status
• Corrective action tracker with overdue flags
• Dashboard with counts, residual risk map and chart
• Hazard library with causes, controls, evidence and indicators
